Person 2 — History & Northern Wei Art

Guyang Cave: Northern Wei Buddhist Art

Begun c. 493 AD · the oldest cave at Longmen

  • Started when Emperor Xiaowen moved the Northern Wei capital to Luoyang
  • Main Buddha: Shakyamuni seated in meditation, with two bodhisattvas
  • Every wall is filled with niches paid for by nobles and monks
  • 19 of the famous “Twenty Calligraphy Masterpieces of Longmen” are carved here

“We had to tilt our heads back — every inch of the walls is carved!”

Walls of niches · the main Buddha (inset)

Person 2 — History & Northern Wei Art

The Beauty of Northern Wei Sculpture

秀

Slender and elegant

Long necks, narrow shoulders and thin faces — the “slender bones, clear features” style

衣

Flowing Chinese robes

Layered robes fall in waterfall-like pleats, after the court adopted Han Chinese dress

笑

A gentle smile

Calm, inward smiles make the Buddhas feel kind and peaceful

0workers and 24 years to carve Binyang Central Cave (finished 523)

Person 2 — History & Northern Wei Art

Luoyang Water Banquet & Beef Soup

Water Banquet 水席

  • Over 1,000 years old, from the Tang dynasty
  • 8 cold + 16 hot dishes = 24
  • Star dish: Peony Swallow Dish — radish shredded like a bird’s nest, topped with a peony

Beef Soup 牛肉汤

  • Locals eat it for breakfast from 6 am
  • Add chilli oil, coriander and green onion
  • Dip the flatbread — and refill the broth for free!

Our verdict: the Water Banquet was beautiful, but beef soup breakfast was the team’s favourite!

Person 3 — Tang Art & Our Experience

The Vairocana Buddha

0 mtotal height
0 mthe head alone
0 meach ear
  • Vairocana is the “Cosmic Buddha”, whose light shines everywhere
  • Tang style: a full, round face, half-closed eyes and a calm smile — powerful but human
  • Legend says the face was modelled on Empress Wu Zetian — the “Mona Lisa of the East”
Northern Wei
slender · distant · mysterious
Tang
full · majestic · human

Person 3 — Tang Art & Our Experience

The Vairocana Buddha in 3D

Cosmic Buddha · Henan, China · Northern Qi dynasty, 550–577 AD · limestone

  • An older “cousin” of the Longmen Vairocana, carved about 100 years earlier
  • His robe is a map of the universe: heavens, Mount Sumeru, the human world — and the hells near the hem

3D scan: Smithsonian National Museum of Asian Art (public domain, CC0)

Person 3 — Tang Art & Our Experience

The Journey Home

Mon 27 Oct · Luoyang Longmen → Zhengzhou East → Zhengzhou Airport → Incheon → SKKU

What we brought home

  • Peony tea and peony-painted porcelain
  • A small Tang three-colour horse replica
  • An ink rubbing of Longmen calligraphy

What we learned

  • Art shows how a country changes: slim Wei → full Tang
  • Emperors, empresses and ordinary people all paid for the caves
  • Food and art together tell a city’s story
